name: Access key created for unexpected user
desc: New IAM access keys outside change-control are credential backdoors.
kql: AWSCloudTrail | where EventName == 'CreateAccessKey' | where UserIdentity.type == 'IAMUser' | where UserIdentity.userName !in (managedCredsUsers)

name: Console login without MFA
desc: Non-MFA console logins from new IPs may be stolen-key use.
kql: AWSCloudTrail | where EventName == 'ConsoleLogin' | where responseElements.AdditionalDetails.MFAUsed != 'Yes' | where sourceIPAddress !in (companyEgressIPs)

name: S3 bucket made public (policy)
desc: Public-principal bucket policy = data exposure or exfil drop.
kql: AWSCloudTrail | where EventName == 'PutBucketPolicy' | where requestParameters.bucketPolicy contains '\"Principal\":\"*\"'

name: Security group wide open
desc: 0.0.0.0/0 ingress to management ports = internet-facing attack surface.
kql: AWSCloudTrail | where EventName == 'AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress' | where requestParameters.ipPermissions contains '0.0.0.0/0'

name: Trail deletion / disable
desc: CloudTrail changes hide everything after them.
kql: AWSCloudTrail | where EventName in ('DeleteTrail','StopLogging','UpdateTrail') | where UserIdentity.arn !in (secops)

name: EC2 instance launched with public IP
desc: Unexpected public instances = crypto or C2 hosting.
kql: AWSCloudTrail | where EventName == 'RunInstances' | where requestParameters.associatePublicIpAddress == 'true'

name: Lambda function new with permissive role
desc: Function roles with broad policies = persistence token.
kql: AWSCloudTrail | where EventName == 'CreateFunction20150331' | where requestParameters.role startsWith 'arn:aws:iam' | where requestParameters.tags doesn't contain 'approved'

name: STS assume-role escalation
desc: AssumeRole to admin role from user context outside SLA.
kql: AWSCloudTrail | where EventName == 'AssumeRole' | where responseElements.credentials.accessKeyId != '' | where eventSource == 'sts.amazonaws.com'

name: Snapshot export of RDS/EBS
desc: Snapshot export = data theft or staging.
kql: AWSCloudTrail | where EventName in ('CopyDBSnapshot','CopySnapshot','StartExportTask')

name: S3 lifecycle deletion
desc: Bulk object deletion from storage = destructive action.
kql: AWSCloudTrail | where EventName in ('DeleteObject','DeleteObjects','PutBucketLifecycleConfiguration')

name: SSH connection from public IP to bastion
desc: Bastion SSH access from non-VPN IPs.
kql: AWSVPCFlow | where dstPort == 22 | where srcAddr !in (vpnCidr)

name: Data transfer cost spike (exfil)
desc: Wide-open egress volume per instance = exfil.
kql: AWSVPCFlow | where action == 'ACCEPT' | where dstAddr notin (privateNetworks) | summarize TotalBytes = sum(bytes) by srcInstanceId, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h) | where TotalBytes > threshold

name: IAM policy with assume-role wildcard
desc: Resource '*' policies can be abused for privilege spread.
kql: AWSCloudTrail | where EventName == 'PutRolePolicy' | where requestParameters.policyDocument contains '\"Resource\":\"*\"'

name: New service-linked role created
desc: Service-linked role additions correlate with new attack surfaces.
kql: AWSCloudTrail | where EventName == 'CreateServiceLinkedRole'

name: CloudShell use by non-admin
desc: Interactive shell in browser = session hijack channel.
kql: AWSCloudTrail | where EventName == 'StartSession' | where userAgent contains 'CloudShell'

name: Entra ID guest account admin role
desc: Guest accounts with directory roles = privilege escalation path.
kql: AuditLogs | where Operation == 'Add member to role' | where TargetResources[0].userPrincipalName contains '#' | where ActivityDisplayName contains 'Global Administrator'

name: Conditional Access policy change
desc: CA policy weakening = MFA bypass prep.
kql: AuditLogs | where Operation in ('Update conditional access policy','Delete conditional access policy') | where ActivityDisplayName contains 'Grant'

name: Excessive PowerShell sign-ins with client app token
desc: Scripted auth (Microsoft.Azure.PowerShell) without MFA = token theft.
kql: SigninLogs | where AppDisplayName contains 'Azure PowerShell' | where AuthenticationRequirement != 'multiFactorAuthentication' | where RiskLevelDuringSignIn == 'high'

name: Azure key vault access from unexpected principal
desc: Vault reads outside service principals break key custody.
kql: AzureDiagnostics | where OperationName has_any ('SecretGet','KeyGet') | where identity.claims['http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2005/05/identity/claims/name'] !in (kvAllowedSpns)

name: Storage account firewall disabled
desc: Public-network access to storage = data exposure.
kql: AzureActivity | where OperationName == 'MICROSOFT.STORAGE/STORAGEACCOUNTS/WRITE' | where Properties contains '\"networkAcls\".*\"defaultAction\":\"Allow\"

name: RBAC role assignment spike
desc: Role grants to new principals — privilege delegation.
kql: AuditLogs | where Operation == 'Add member to role' | where TargetResources[0].type == 'User' | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m) | where count_ > 5

name: VM with exposed management port
desc: NSG allowing 22/3389 from Internet.
kql: AzureNetworkAnalytics_CL | where DestinationPort in (22,3389) | where SourceIPAddress_Prefix == '0.0.0.0/0'

name: App registration new credentials
desc: New client secrets/certs on apps — credential addition persistence.
kql: AuditLogs | where Operation in ('Add application secret','Add application certificate') | where TargetResources[0].displayName !in (managedApps)

name: Azure AD risky sign-in tombstone
desc: Risky sign-ins that fail then succeed = password spray success.
kql: SigninLogs | where RiskDetail == 'userPassswordLeak' or RiskDetail == 'userRiskDetected' | where ResultType == '0'

name: Legacy auth success after block
desc: Basic auth endpoints used after modern-auth enforcement = scripted attacks.
kql: SigninLogs | where AuthenticationRequirement contains 'legacy' | where ResultType == '0'

name: Service account key creation (GCP)
desc: New SA keys are long-lived credentials.
kql: GCPAuditLogs | where operation.method == 'CreateServiceAccountKey' | where actor.email !in (authorizedAdminEmails)

name: IAM policy grant to allUsers (GCP)
desc: allUsers/allAuthenticatedUsers grants = public data access.
kql: GCPAuditLogs | where operation.method == 'SetIamPolicy' | where resource.securityCenterProperties contains 'allUsers'

name: Firewall rule allowing 0.0.0.0/0 (GCP)
desc: Public ingress to GCP VMs.
kql: GCPAuditLogs | where operation.method == 'compute.firewalls.insert' | where request contains '0.0.0.0/0'

name: GCS bucket IAM change
desc: Bucket ACL/policy changes = exposure or staging.
kql: GCPAuditLogs | where operation.method has_any ('storage.buckets.setIamPolicy','storage.objects.insert') | where resource.labels.bucket_name !in (managedBuckets)

name: Compute instance stopped + disk exported
desc: Disk image export = VM theft / evidence-stage.
kql: GCPAuditLogs | where operation.method has_any ('compute.disks.insert','compute.images.insert','compute.disks.createSnapshot')

name: gcloud identity from unexpected network
desc: API calls from fresh IPs/UA for existing service accounts.
kql: GCPAuditLogs | where protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail endswith '.gserviceaccount.com' | where protoPayload.requestMetadata.callerIp !in (authorizedIpBlocks)

name: BigQuery dataset public read
desc: Dataset ACL allowing allUsers/allAuthenticatedUsers.
kql: GCPAuditLogs | where operation.method == 'bigquery.datasets.update' | where resource contains 'allUsers'

name: IAM role escalation via policy binding
desc: Binding users to roles they shouldn't hold.
kql: GCPAuditLogs | where operation.method == 'setIamPolicy' | where protoPayload.request.policy contains 'roles/owner' or 'roles/admin'

name: K8s service account token abuse
desc: Cluster roles granting secret access to default SAs.
kql: K8sAuditLogs | where verb in ('create','patch') | where objectRef.resource in ('rolebindings','clusterrolebindings') | where requestObject contains 'secrets'

name: Pod exec into namespace
desc: exec sessions into pods = container escape attempts.
kql: K8sAuditLogs | where verb == 'create' | where objectRef.subresource == 'exec' | where user.username !in (allowedOperators)

name: Privileged container creation
desc: privileged:true pods = escape-ready.
kql: K8sAuditLogs | where objectRef.resource == 'pods' | where requestObject contains 'privileged' and requestObject contains 'true'

name: K8s secret read burst
desc: Volume secret reads = credential harvesting.
kql: K8sAuditLogs | where objectRef.resource == 'secrets' | where verb in ('get','list') | summarize count() by user.username, bin(TimeGenerated, 15m) | where count_ > 20

name: Cluster-admin bind
desc: cluster-admin grants in audit log = escalation.
kql: K8sAuditLogs | where objectRef.resource contains 'clusterrolebinding' | where requestObject contains 'cluster-admin'

name: CloudTrail stopped by K8s workload
desc: Workload IAM used to disable audit trail.
kql: AWSCloudTrail | where EventName == 'StopLogging' | let t = TimeGenerated | join kind=inner (K8sAuditLogs) on TimeGenerated | where t - TimeGenerated < 5m

name: CI/CD pipeline secret exposure
desc: Build logs containing secrets = supply-chain exposure.
kql: CIBuildLogs | where BuildResult contains 'secret' or BuildResult contains 'AKIA' or BuildResult contains '-----BEGIN'
